notes.title: Christmas Event!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’d like to wish you the best for the upcoming Christmas and the New Year! 🎁 To give Miniland Adventure a more Christmasy vibe, we’re happy to introduce the new thematic patch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/c8be0067cbbb3400d6759e4cb7f87c333392cc09.png[/img]
[h3]Throughout this entire event your character will be wearing a classic Santa cap and snow will be falling in the main menu! ❄️ We’ve also slightly altered its looks. 🙂[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/cad5865332917a739ff205cb54d6e7f3b55739db.png[/img]
We’ve also prepared a few cool cosmetics for you to decorate your bases. A snowman ⛄ which is a standalone decoration made via furniture table and Christmas lights 💡 which can be hang on the trees. You can prepare them using red, green and blue night lamps at your workbench. 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/e08a8cabd38ea74649d3f1b6076dc684887f306e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/8c08cdee913d458cd16c7dcf07a032e327e89f96.png[/img]
The decorations won’t disappear once the event is over on December 31st but the same can’t be said about the altered looks of the menu and Santa Hat. 

We’ve also fixed the bug where the lava left after activating the lava trap was not being saved properly. 🔥

As always we’d like to invite you to join our discord community where you can meet other Miniland players! 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/98fe03af0748de84689470794a42c6e07b0687ec.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Adventurers! 👋[/b][/h1]

It's been almost half a year since the release of Miniland Adventure. What a journey it was! We'd like to thank all of you who followed us on any step of it 😊. We wonder how many of you were with us from the very beginning, let us know in the comments! 💖 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/27e8d86332861556cd7cd4023475538699fa450b.png[/img]

We couldn't imagine better moment to say the following statement, so without further ado:

The long awaited patch is live! 😯🔥 Last time, we've briefly introduced some of its contents and today, we'll show you all of the novelties! 🤩 

In case you've just started following us on Steam, let's take a quick look at the already announced changes and move on to the features yet to be uncovered. 📝

[h3][b]-New kind of enemy: witches! 🧹[/b][/h3]
Those vile enemies skilled in magic will spell your doom with their AoE degeneration ground- approach. The witches reside both in the overworld and enchanted dimension!

[h3][b]-New building: healing statue! ➕[/b][/h3]
This statue offers a powerful healing aura in its vicinity. Can become a powerful defensive structure if placed strategically! 🛡️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/1fcdb389f6e71e3fe62d3c1f02f45434704c75dd.png[/img]
[h3][b]-In-game biome modding! 🗺️[/b][/h3]
Create your own completely unique biome tiles using all the elements available in game. It's time to let your imagination run wild! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2aface4937972c8ca6ba486e9a0541bebc5f1f07.png[/img]
[h3][b]-New object: Anvil 🔨[/b][/h3]
Repair old, used up weapons and tools. Let them have a second life. 

[h3][b]-New object: Text Sign 🛑[/b][/h3]
Ability to Create and place signs with custom Text, resembling the ones in the tutorial. We wonder what kind of use they will find in your worlds. 🤔

[h3][b]-New weapon: Hammer ⚒️[/b][/h3]
This will become a refreshing addition in your arsenal. Although it's slow, the high damage and range compensates for it allowing you to wreak havoc whenever you choose to weld it! 

[h3][b]-New growable flower! 🌸[/b][/h3]
The patch allows you to have a bigger bunch of flowers growing in your biomes, by growing them with a use of bone meal!

[h3][b]-Goblins are immortal! [/b][/h3]
No more losing your green friends accidentally.😁

[h3][b]-Fixed duplication bug[/b][/h3]
The bug making objects drop duplicated items if destroyed by multiple projectiles. 

[b]Last but not least, we've added modding document action available for everyone in the "help" section of the mod menu[/b]. You can find hints on modding the game in our previous post so be sure to take a look there!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1934040/view/3736356443994842337

We can't wait to see what kind of use you will make with the new features presented in the patch. Join our discord 👇and let us know! 

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/98fe03af0748de84689470794a42c6e07b0687ec.png[/img][/url]

See you soon, 
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Mods
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Adventurers! 👋[/b][/h1]

The update is just around the corner and before it’s launched we’d like to give you some heads up about the feature most of you are eagerly waiting for- [b]the modding process[/b]. Therefore, this detailed instruction is issued! 👍

To get the process started, first you have to enter the new biome section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/b0a4bdc492cb673155526bd0454163edd4608028.png[/img]
When you open it, a big panel will appear. It has all the details about the biome you create. Let’s take a closer look at each of them, shall we? 🔍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2aface4937972c8ca6ba486e9a0541bebc5f1f07.png[/img]
[h3][b]Biome Name[/b][/h3]
Choose a suitable name for your creation in the center top tile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6b283443ebc895331aebad50fb227a3a63cb7253.png[/img]
[h3][b]Tile Type[/b][/h3]
This option dictates what type of ground will appear on the biome and consequently, what kind of monsters you will encounter there. 🧟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/20166ccc4fb09be9e8ff18a872041343b45f2aba.png[/img]
[h3][b]Biome Type[/b][/h3]
Once you’ve decided on the type of tiles you have to decide what kind of Underground and Enchanted Dimension appears on your map. Select carefully to ensure the best effect! 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/f0d23e7355ba6dd263c2ecc01c1189ed7dc2f148.png[/img]
[h3][b]Mobs and Objects[/b][/h3]
Once you’ve decided the looks on your biome we can start putting objects on it. On the biomes, you can put up to one mob and 5 objects. Each of them has a number right to their name. This number represents the percentage chance for appearance of said object/mob. 

[h3]Let’s take a look at the example below and talk about the math behind it 📝[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/7e518c4d167f0dc60968e5eae91625373baf1465.png[/img]
As you can see, the objects’ chances in the example sum up to 27.5%. What it basically means is that about 27.5% of tiles on that biome will have some kind of object or mob when placed, while the rest of the area will have nothing on it. In the area taken by objects, the chances for each specific one are proportional to the values you’ve set.

[h3][b]Make sure to have the total chances for the objects not exceed 100%, otherwise some objects will not be able to spawn at all. 🙁[/b][/h3]

And this is how the final effect looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/29aaea752d35547f0944625b7deea55d895fdf24.png[/img]
[h3][b]How to disable/enable or remove mods[/b][/h3]
if you have mods that you don’t want to activate at the moment, you can simply disable or enable the ones you’d like to have again in the mod manager section.

All you have to do is to click on the big round button to the left of the mod’s name and voila, you’ve disabled/enabled the mod. By the way, to the right there is a delete button in case you don’t want to have the mod anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/783a7f3d7fe3fdffa07f67208e54298c8d6ef9ef.png[/img]
[h3][b]How to add mods[/b][/h3]
We’d like to allow the community to share their creations with each other hence we introduced a way to add mods created by other people. The procedure is really simple and quick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/e1559b23af8c817a5674523b8edd9067f2bca86b.png[/img]
All you have to do is download the mod file you’d like to add and place it in the mod folder. Pay attention so that the file has the .json format. To quickly enter this folder, all you have to do is to click the folder button in the Modding window in the game. Don’t forget to restart your game afterwards 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/03e81a31da015286d439df72b231f6f6a031459c.png[/img]
Hopefully you’ll find this instruction helpful and clear. If you’d like us to address any other mechanic in the game with an instruction news like this one don’t hesitate to let us know on our discord 👇 or in the comments/discussions on Steam. We can’t wait to see where creativity takes you once the patch is released. 

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/98fe03af0748de84689470794a42c6e07b0687ec.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Novelties!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Adventurers! 👋[/b][/h1]

It’s been a while since you’ve heard from us but we’re finally back with [b]information about another content patch[/b]. 🤩 Today, we’d like to give you a glimpse of what’s going to be introduced in the future update! 🔥

[h3][b]The developer works tirelessly to bring new content[/b] to the game and the first feature he’s prepared for you is [b]in-game biome modding[/b]! 😀 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/c14adc56d50d5b5ce6200411674dcbef6ece1a7c.png[/img]
With this [b]we’d like to give you even more freedom[/b]. [b]Create custom biomes using various resources available in the game[/b] such as animals, objects and more! 🤯 Once saved, you’ll be able to obtain and place the biomes just as you’d do with the standard ones. [b]We can’t wait to see where your creativity will take you so make sure to share your projects with us on our discord![/b] 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/732e78bb6bb96f2dcf7dd9ba3563963474b96e82.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Let’s take a look at a biome we’ve prepared for demonstration purposes- the Moth Biome.🔍[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/3d13abc0a81bf172e1522752610fe2b939dd8555.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/df576a61c4de223b4f67eb3b6c489e81d4c7dcff.png[/img]
[h3]The sheer amount of possible combinations will allow you to have a world like no other player! 🙂[/h3]

This content patch will also bring [b]new objects[/b], like a [b]healing statue[/b] ➕ which as the name implies gives a healing aura in a small area around it. This object will allow you to heal up after a tough battle or even support you during combat if built strategically. ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/1fcdb389f6e71e3fe62d3c1f02f45434704c75dd.png[/img]
On top of that, you’ll encounter [b]new enemies - witches[/b]. They are aggressive beings skilled in magical art who use their AOE degeneration magic to bring demise to the players. ☠️ You can meet two kinds of witches, the normal ones reside in the main dimension while the other, even more dangerous dwell in the depths of the enchanted dimension. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/3347e2d491d77f8dbfe73f726b9a2434e063fa73.png[/img]
[h3][b]Those are just some of the features the patch will bring to the game 📝 so make sure to keep a close eye on the notifications and newses because we’ll reveal even more features as the update is near! 🔥[/b][/h3]

See you soon
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Major Update 🔔
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello players! [/b][/h1]

[h3]Today we come to you with great news, and the finale of our work over the past weeks!

Last time we described to you some of the new features that will appear in our game with the upcoming game update. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1934040/view/3704817293707728983?l=english]These included new biomes, new objects to create and also new creatures, eg. cats 🐈 which can be tamed[/url] 💘[/h3]

[h2]While we did not give you a specific release date at the time, we will not keep you in suspense any longer. [b]The update is now available![/b] [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/7649938efb0389413dc83d80d713cbb1e005d594.png[/img]


[b]With it comes even more news and surprises we have prepared for you 😀.[/b]


[h2][b]New passive mobs 👹:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Jellyfish[/b] 🐠, appearing in the enchanted forest.
[*] [b]A cat[/b] 😼 that you can tame by wearing a collar! Tamed cats will follow you and you can also let them sit in one place .
[/list]


[h2][b]Biomes 🧊 : [/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Cherry blossom forest 🌸[/b], giving you the opportunity to make decorations, floors and walls out of pink wood 🪓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/57486eb955de9828e7b302da21891b506f9ac2a8.png[/img]

[*] [b]Limestone cave 🕳️[/b] , where you will find materials such as : limestone, stalagmites or polluted water, and get the opportunity to create: limestone floors, walls and decorations 🎍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/009bfba770ded06b1afe0633a104fc3ca49d161b.png[/img]

[*] [b]Charred forest 🌳 🔥[/b] , will be a good place to collect dark pepper, charred tree, and glowing bugs which will be a great raw material to create colorful night lights! 🏮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/b95a4b6fd27eed3d3fff973ef3cff2777714ef7d.png[/img]
[/list]


[h2][b]New trap 😛 :[/b][/h2]
 
[list]
[*] [b]A spiked trap[/b] that deals damage to anyone who steps on it 🗡️
[/list]



[h2][b]Additional patches and fixes 🛠️ :  [/b][/h2]

[b][h3]Improvements :[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*] added interactive UI animations
[*] slightly changed stone wall sprites to make it more appealing
[*] added a mention in the tutorial about collecting liquids
[*] added light to explosions
[/list]

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] fixed a bug where some monsters could be duplicated when being saved for the first time
[*] fixed a bug where ungrown acacia would drop standard log instead of red log
[/olist]



[h2][b]Thank you for being with us and continuing to support us![/b] 
We hope you will enjoy the new content and improve the positive feeling from playing our [b]Miniland Adventure![/b][/h2]


[h2][b]We invite you to our discord, where we share interesting facts related to the production of :[/b][/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png[/img][/url]


[b]See you soon,
Miniland Adventure Team[/b]

notes.title: Upcoming update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello players! 🤝[/b][/h1]

[h3]It's been a month since the release of the full version of our Miniland Adventure! 📆 During this time we have collected a lot of feedback, kind words and constructive criticism from you 🥳 for which we sincerely thank you.
Your presence is very important to us, because it is for you - our players - that we create our game❣️[/h3]

[h3][b]We want to gladly inform you that your requests and suggestions are not sent to us in vain, and we plan to further develop our Miniland Adventure game 😀 And now, in this post, we'll let out a bit of a secret and describe to you what will be included in the upcoming update in the near future. New opportunities, a new area to explore and new animals.... 🐈[/b][/h3]

[b]In the upcoming update[/b] you will have the unique opportunity to discover and enjoy the beauty of the new [b]"Cherry blossom tree biome" [/b]🌸 
But that's not all!
There will also be a new [b]"Underground biome"[/b] 🤯 and an [b]"Enchanted dimension biome"[/b] ✨


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/57486eb955de9828e7b302da21891b506f9ac2a8.png[/img]

Along with the new biomes, you will be able to find brand new resources with the help of which [b]you will be able to create new magnificent objects, furniture or house elements[/b] 🏠


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/009bfba770ded06b1afe0633a104fc3ca49d161b.png[/img]

That couldn't be all 🙂 Due to your requests, there will also be brand new animals and monsters living in new biomes in Miniland Adventure. [b]Among other things, player-friendly, adorable cats will appear![/b] 😼


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/8924132664ec6da5c45e3cca360827b841918676.png[/img]

[h3]Of course, these are not all the novelties we are planning for the upcoming update 👍 We will describe the rest to you at a slightly later date ⏰[/h3]


[b]Remember that we are still working on the content of this update and it will take us some more time. [/b]We want the new content of the game to meet your expectations the most 🎉 Expect to hear more about the upcoming update, and [b]join our Discord[/b], as it's also there, you have a say in the news coming to the game! 


[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png[/img][/url]

There will also be a new "Underground biome" 🤯 and an "Enchanted dimension biome" ✨
Along with the new biomes, you will be able to find brand new resources with the help of which you will be able to create new magnificent objects, furniture or house elements 🏠

That couldn't be all 🙂 Due to your requests, there will also be brand new animals and monsters living in new biomes in Miniland Adventure. Among other things, player-friendly, adorable cats will appear! 😼

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h3][b]Version 1.0.5 changelogs:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where goblin's could "forget" their beds.
[*] Lowered drops from vegetables (eg. radishes, broccoli etc.) - we've seen it was too easy to get a lot of vegetables.

notes.title: Game modes, difficulty settings, thirst and all kinds of water💦
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Minilanders[/b]!⛏️[/h1]
We have a lot of news coming to you about the [b]development[/b] of the game, lots of new stuff for every type of player to enjoy!🤗

[h1][b]New items and what to use them for![/b]🥤[/h1]
You can get [b]salt water[/b] from an [b]ocean[/b]🌊 by using a bucket or a [b]cup[/b] (new item yay!) which was added in this [b]update[/b].
[b]Sweet water[/b] is acquirable by collecting it with a bucket from the [b]enchanted dimension[/b] 🧝‍♂️ or by boiling the salt water in a furnace.🔥

Additionally a [b]new water distributor[/b] enables storing sweet water and dispensing it at any given time (up to 8 [b]cups[/b] storage wise).📠
Bucket holds as much as 3 [b]cups[/b] but you can’t drink out of it. Cups can also be stacked as well as a great number of other items so you can hold many of them in your inventory.🤓
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/9f8b87951b0fa671ad2b70079e7080e9fed74733.png[/img]
[h1][b]Introducing, thirst[/b]😫
[/h1][b]Thirst[/b] works the same way as food - it gradually falls until it reaches 0, then the player starts receiving damage. The difference is however that regenerating health uses food points, but [b]water level[/b] won’t get reduced (a little less to worry about!).🚱

[h1][b]Modes and difficulty levels[/b] 🎮[/h1]
[b]Survival[/b] mode is the standard one that’s always been there. In the [b]creative[/b] one however we get access to all the items which we can add to our inventory when we want!
We also can’t die💀 meaning when our health points go down to zero, nothing will happen and we can peacefully continue with what we were doing.👼
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/297fac0f610515fa7ccf130c9b9591011083546d.png[/img]
Separate from that, there’s also the ability to choose different [b]difficulty levels[/b] ([b]no monsters[/b], [b]easy, normal, hard[/b]).
[b]No monsters[/b] means everything else is the same, the only thing that changes is that when it’s night; the [b]monsters[/b] won’t spawn.👺
[b]Easy[/b] difficulty means less damage received and more food, water and health points gained.😌
[b]Hard[/b] mode is the opposite of [b]easy[/b] and has a purpose to give you more challenge if you like to fight with monsters.⚔

[h1][b]“Localization”[/b][/h1]
We are also working on localizing the game and soon there will be much more languages available to enjoy the game in!🥳
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/593bf7e017a7fd09ed84646d6706770b23d79af4.png[/img]
That’s all the news from us (just for now 😉), we hope you enjoyed this update and are excited for the things to come!

If you are as excited as we are, come talk with us on the [b]Discord![/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/xsDhbYeN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png[/img][/url]

Also, add the game to your wishlist to get the newest information about the game delivered straight to you!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/

Land on you soon!
The Miniland Team

notes.title: New enchanted dimension!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]This time the theme of our works is magic and enchanted objects! 🎩✨
We have gone to great lengths to create a whole new dimension for you to explore in our[b] Miniland[/b] game! [/h3]

[h2][b]
A new enchanted dimension  ✨[/b][/h2]

This month, much of our work has been focused on creating a new area to explore, mine, harvest new plants and fight scary monsters!
The passage to it leads you through a portal that you will be able to create 👏


We have made every effort to refine the[b] new dimension[/b] as much as possible! Large magic mushrooms, magic trees, grass, water to give the right atmosphere, lava - all this will create a unique environment that we hope will delight you 🤩.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/dcefbc025222c48f14118125aabc0deef20a5857.gif[/img]



[h2][b]New objects in-game 🪑[/b][/h2]

[b]That's not all ❗ [/b]
The game will also feature brand new materials for building furniture, walls or floors - which will allow you to build even better buildings.

Are you curious if something else will appear? Of course 🙂 To craft some magical objects, you will also need an [b]enchanted crafting table![/b]  To create them, you will need the right magical objects and raw materials - [b]including the new "Obsidian", which is a rather fragile but extremely powerful raw material[/b] - and as a result, you will get a unique opportunity to create other magical objects too! Among them, a [b]soup of magic mushrooms[/b] that gives extra life 🍄.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/5b33642f93c43808ca9d7d8d481c8642c3022053.gif[/img]



[h2][b]All-new monsters 👹[/b][/h2]


The new monsters appearing in the Enchanted Dimension will be as interesting as the location itself 😎 They will be : 

👻[b] Ghost[/b] - only appears when it is close to the player, it is impossible to attack it from afar. You are left with a skirmish in a direct confrontation 👊

🧱[b] Mimic[/b] - Hides in the walls in the enchanted dimension, reveals itself when you hit it.

🔫 [b]Cultist[/b] - Shoots several projectiles at once, charging his projectiles continuously. In an ongoing battle he will be able to fire fewer projectiles, but after a long pause he will be able to attack the player with more of them, creating a salvo! 


[h3][b]Keep your eyes peeled and be careful ⛑️[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/ca6378abbc487dc37245e46206dde0dc91bc4c0e.gif[/img]




[h2][b]Other enhancements and novelties added to the game:[/b][/h2]


[b]- A new weapon : spear[/b] that has a large damage and the ability to throw it

[b]- Better floor system[/b]. Floor now adjusts to the walls built instead of sticking outside the houses.



[h3][b]Thank you for being with us, and we invite you to join our Discord! There you will be able to talk with both the game's creator and other players interested in similar game topics 👇[/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png[/img][/url]


[h3][b]We also encourage you to add the [b]Miniland[/b] game to your Wishlist. That way you won't miss any information about our game! 👌[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/

See You soon,
Miniland Team

notes.title: Devlog#2 - Exploding spiders
notes.content:
[h1][b]🎮  Hello players!  🎮[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]It's high time to attack you with another dose of knowledge on Miniland development. [/b][/h3]

For today we have prepared a lot of different kinds of new gameplay elements - from the environment of our map to completely new monsters :) A real rarity for any fan.

[h3][b]LET'S BEGIN!
[/b]
[/h3]
[h2][b]
The first and very interesting issue is spiders 🕷️ and the ability to craft weapons from them and fully functional goblins :[/b][/h2]

[b]Spiders [/b] 🕷️  appear in the most convenient environment for them - the underground. They are extremely dangerous, cunning and have an "explosive" character  💥  Literally 😎
After their death they mercilessly explode thus inflicting damage on us. But to give you something in return, you have the opportunity to take from them an explosive substance that will allow you to build a [b]bomb[/b].  💣


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/3afc2cf59ab19c7f1c057130bc8b418f487d81f3.gif[/img]



[b]Goblins[/b] 👺 are very interesting and definitely important characters in our game. 
They appear every few days, right after laying down new biomes. Since they will not have any shelter once we approach them, they will follow us. 
In the game there is an option to build them [b]a bed[/b]  🛏️, which they will take ownership of after we lead them to it. 
From there, it's a straightforward way to raise their satisfaction level by building them a nice house with furniture that matches their tastes! [b]Remember - the higher the goblin's satisfaction, the better offers you’ll get[/b] 💰 The items they sell will be directly related to the profession a particular goblin has, so it's important to treat each of them as well as possible. As if that wasn't enough, some of the items are only available to buy from goblins and can't be obtained in any other way (e.g. pumpkin seeds).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/473980c793da3e22b9434e5536b2d937c00340f5.gif[/img]



[b]Raise the satisfaction level of your goblins and enjoy fantastic trade offers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/a4f3ac8d70659ef84b07c3878d13364497321e53.gif[/img]



[h2][b]Next in line are changes to the UI windows, facilitation and the overall look of the map :[/b][/h2]

- We have adapted the entire UI of the game to larger monitors, so that everything is more readable for you.
- We've redesigned the furnace in such a way that it doesn't burn objects immediately, but as time passes. Of course, we also added all-new fantastic animations and effects :)
- We increased the number of objects in one stack from 8 to 16
- Ability to build vertical doors
- Now only part of the biomes is random, the rest is adjusted so that we have the greatest possible variety of terrain




[h2][b]
At the very end we left the biggest surprise that will eminently catch your eye ! Water in the background of the game !  🌊 [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/06230df071a78c2be02bb7fdcb07dd5706f113c6.gif[/img]

So far, only the steady color was visible in the background. We decided to give you more fun and a sense of boundlessness - [b]the sea.[/b] 🌊   No more great emptiness, from now on there will be something to look at! 



[h3][b]What do you think about these types of changes? Let us know here or on our discord [/b][/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png[/img][/url]


[h3][b]If you are curious about the next devlog, be sure to add miniland to your steam Wishlist [/b][/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/



See You Soon,
Miniland Team

notes.title: Devlog #1 New monsters and tools
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋 [/b][/h1]
How are you? We hope you are fine and are ready for a whole new dose of information about our [b]MINILAND[/b] game!

Ready? Let's start ❗

[b][h3]There are many tools in the game that we need to expand and protect our land.

Among others, these are:[/h3][/b][list][*] Sword
[*] Axe
[*] Pickaxe
[*] Slingshot  and more[/list]
[b]SHEARS FOR SHEARING SHEEP[/b] 🐑  joined the group of these tools! 
[b]But don't worry, that's not all[/b] - in addition to the possibility of obtaining wool, there is also the durability of the tool you are using. So be careful what and how you do as any tool you use in the game will break after long use. 💔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/c1633515b251bb664d4da85c06ee204507bc6790.gif[/img]

[h3][b][h3]In addition to new tools, Miniland also has a new monster that threatens our land:[/h3][/b][/h3]

[b]Mummy. [/b]
The mummy will appear on sand biomes and will attack us with fireballs to scare us away from its territory!  🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6357a9799ce5d3a3a4d8359d90be867309384aa1.gif[/img]

We've also started work on [b]Goblin[/b]  😈  NPCs we'll be building rooms for, and we'll talk more about them in the next devlogs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/e5e8227e3a238c77ef0730dc77f8474d696af432.gif[/img]

We make every effort to ensure that you enjoy the game in [b]every aspect[/b], including the visual experience. We've added a lot of [b]cool ambient effects[/b] to make it much easier for you to get into the atmosphere of our game.

Imagine it: The flickering lights of a torch, a path through an endless clearing full of flowers and a skeleton coming out from around the corner … ☠️

[b]Fantastic, right? [/b]

[h3]Remember that you decide what your world will look like! 💪 [/h3]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list][*] Gamepad support added
[*] Improved optimization, allowing more mobs in one area
[*] Bug fixes[/list]

[h3]Finally, we would like to invite you to our server on DISCORD, where you can share your suggestions with us and chat directly with the Game Developer! 👇 [/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/732e78bb6bb96f2dcf7dd9ba3563963474b96e82.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Add Minilad to your Steam Wishlist to stay up to date with all the information and news about our production![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/

[b]See You soon,
Miniland Team[/b]

notes.title: Update v0.11
notes.content:
[h3]I've finished working on the 11th update for Miniland, which means we're slowly but steadily closer to the release.[/h3]

Some of the new features are:
[list]
[*] Added over 40 sounds and a first music that plays in the morning
[*] New monster - a snowman spawning on ice biome and shooting ice cubes
[*] Added swords for a melee combat
[*] Lasso can be used to tie animals and drag them around
[*] Bone meal made from bones, used to speed up growing plants
[*] Ostriches now lay eggs which you can hatch or eat
[*] New UI look and improved crafting
[*] "Mountain" biome - a biome with big stone chunks on the surface
[*] Mouse sprites
[*] Many bug fixes and improvements
[/list]
